From 73b5ab27ab2ee616f2709dc212c2b0007894a12e Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Hsiao Chien Sung <shawn.sung@mediatek.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Dec 2023 13:58:46 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] drm/mediatek: Fix underrun in VDO1 when switches off the
 layer

Do not reset Merge while using CMDQ because reset API doesn't
wait for frame done event as CMDQ does and could lead to
underrun when the layer is switching off.

Fixes: aaf94f7c3ae6 ("drm/mediatek: Add display merge async reset control")

Reviewed-by: CK Hu <ck.hu@mediatek.com>
Reviewed-by: AngeloGioacchino Del Regno <angelogioacchino.delregno@collabora.com>
Signed-off-by: Hsiao Chien Sung <shawn.sung@mediatek.com>
Link: https://patchwork.kernel.org/project/dri-devel/patch/20231214055847.4936-23-shawn.sung@mediatek.com/
Signed-off-by: Chun-Kuang Hu <chunkuang.hu@kernel.org>

diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/mediatek/mtk_disp_merge.c b/drivers/gpu/drm/mediatek/mtk_disp_merge.c
index e525a6b9e5b0..22f768d923d5 100644
--- a/drivers/gpu/drm/mediatek/mtk_disp_merge.c
+++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/mediatek/mtk_disp_merge.c
@@ -103,7 +103,7 @@ void mtk_merge_stop_cmdq(struct device *dev, struct cmdq_pkt *cmdq_pkt)
 	mtk_ddp_write(cmdq_pkt, 0, &priv->cmdq_reg, priv->regs,
 		      DISP_REG_MERGE_CTRL);
 
-	if (priv->async_clk)
+	if (!cmdq_pkt && priv->async_clk)
 		reset_control_reset(priv->reset_ctl);
 }
 
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/gpu/drm/mediatek/mtk_disp_merge.c`**
   - The condition for resetting the `priv->reset_ctl` has been modified. 
   - The original line:
     ```c
     if (priv->async_clk)
     ```
     has been changed to:
     ```c
     if (!cmdq_pkt && priv->async_clk)
     ```
   - This change ensures that the reset of the `Merge` control is only performed when `cmdq_pkt` is `NULL` and `priv->async_clk` is true.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The modification addresses a bug related to an underrun issue in the VDO1 layer when it is switched off. By changing the condition under which the reset occurs, the patch prevents the reset from happening when a command queue packet (`cmdq_pkt`) is in use. This is crucial because the reset API does not wait for the frame done event, which could lead to the underrun problem. Thus, the relationship between the modification and the bug fix is that the new condition helps maintain proper synchronization during the layer's shutdown process, thereby resolving the underrun issue.

Here is the commit message:
drm/mediatek: Fix underrun in VDO1 when switches off the
 layer

Do not reset Merge while using CMDQ because reset API doesn't
wait for frame done event as CMDQ does and could lead to
underrun when the layer is switching off.

Fixes: aaf94f7c3ae6 ("drm/mediatek: Add display merge async reset control")

Reviewed-by: CK Hu <ck.hu@mediatek.com>
Reviewed-by: AngeloGioacchino Del Regno <angelogioacchino.delregno@collabora.com>
Signed-off-by: Hsiao Chien Sung <shawn.sung@mediatek.com>
Link: https://patchwork.kernel.org/project/dri-devel/patch/20231214055847.4936-23-shawn.sung@mediatek.com/
Signed-off-by: Chun-Kuang Hu <chunkuang.hu@kernel.org>

Here is the root cause:
The bug is caused by the reset of the `Merge` control being executed without waiting for the frame done event when using the reset API, which can lead to an underrun condition when the layer is being switched off. This occurs because the reset API does not synchronize with the command queue, resulting in potential data loss or corruption during the transition.

Here is the patch:
 
 void mtk_merge_stop_cmdq(struct device *dev, struct cmdq_pkt *cmdq_pkt)
 {
 	struct mtk_disp_merge *priv = dev_get_drvdata(dev);
 
 	if (priv->mute_support)
 		mtk_ddp_write(cmdq_pkt, 0x1, &priv->cmdq_reg, priv->regs,
 			      DISP_REG_MERGE_MUTE_0);
 
 	mtk_ddp_write(cmdq_pkt, 0, &priv->cmdq_reg, priv->regs,
 		      DISP_REG_MERGE_CTRL);
 
-	if (priv->async_clk)
+	if (!cmdq_pkt && priv->async_clk)
 		reset_control_reset(priv->reset_ctl);
 }

Reason:
The bug occurs because the `reset_control_reset` function is called without ensuring that the command queue (`cmdq_pkt`) has completed its operations. This can lead to an underrun condition when the layer is being switched off, as the reset API does not wait for the frame done event, resulting in potential data loss or corruption during the transition.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
if (!cmdq_pkt && priv->async_clk)
```
```c
reset_control_reset(priv->reset_ctl);
```
Reason:
The fix modifies the condition to check if `cmdq_pkt` is not present before calling `reset_control_reset`. This ensures that the reset is only executed when the command queue is not in use, preventing the underrun condition by allowing the command queue to complete its operations before resetting the `Merge` control.
